authorityBoundary.D09: owns point-in-time industry classification, persistent sector relative strength/breadth and peer-universe state
authorityBoundary.D10: owns supply-chain/economic relationship edges when a causal industrial transmission mechanism is claimed
authorityBoundary.D17: owns only event-specific propagation state from the event anchor into a pre-frozen peer set

boundedWitness.interpretation: This current-source witness demonstrates that a bounded same-industry peer set can be constructed. Prospective studies must use the D09 point-in-time classification vintage at or before the event decision clock rather than backfill today's classification.

replayContract: Freeze peer membership before reading peer returns/outcomes.
Anchor the event to D17/D11 PIT event receipt and use D17-12 post-open path only after the anchor opening observation.
A same-industry label establishes a candidate peer set, not a same-sign causal mechanism.
If a supply-chain/customer relation is invoked, consume D10's effective-dated economic edge rather than recreating one in D17.
Market/sector common movement and persistent sector RS remain controls/owners in D09; they are not duplicate D17 votes.
Competition and substitution can invert sign; absence of a verified mechanism remains UNKNOWN/ATTENTION_ONLY rather than forced contagion.
falsification: An issuer-specific clinical milestone may have no effect on unrelated same-industry firms.
A competitor success can be negative for a rival through substitution even when both share an industry code.
A common regulatory shock can move peers together without the anchor firm causing the peer move.
Post-event peer co-movement alone cannot prove the transmission edge.

maturityDecision.basis: D09 already provides Taiwan PIT-feasible classification/sector state, D17 provides PIT event identity, and validated price-path sources support later peer-path measurement. A bounded current peer witness confirms operational source construction. Explicit mechanism/UNKNOWN states and owner boundaries prevent same-industry co-movement from becoming an assumed causal sign.
notClaimed: historical classification backfill from current source

exactNext: Prospectively freeze peer sets on independent events using D09 classification vintages before outcomes.
Collect divergent cases: contagion, competition/substitution, and no propagation.
Use D10 economic edges only where a causal supply-chain transmission claim is made.
Before L4, test event-specific propagation incremental value beyond persistent D09 sector RS/breadth and market controls.
